transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I'm just having a hard time lately. I can't really shake this... heavy feeling. It's just hopeless, I guess. It kind of feels like everything I tried to build after my divorce just... collapsed. And I'm just sitting under it.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, hopeless feeling?
Um... about a month, I guess. It kind of started when... when all the financial stuff from the divorce really hit. But yeah, about a month.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like before this heavy feeling started?
Um... I don't know. Not really, I guess. I just... I haven't really been doing much of anything anyway. So... yeah.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't find pleasure in them?
I mean... like I said, I just haven't really been doing much. I can't really think of anything specific right now. Just... nothing really sounds good, I guess.
Are there things you used to enjoy that you still do, but don't enjoy as much as you used to?
I really don't know. Um... I just do what I have to do to get by right now. I'm not really paying attention to whether it's enjoyable or not.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to like?
I mean... yeah, probably. It's just... like I was saying, I don't really care about much of anything lately. I don't know what else to tell you.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite lately?
Not really. Um... I just eat when I need to, I guess. I haven't really thought about it.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean, I'll just lie there for hours, just... staring at the ceiling. Thinking about work, or... bills I need to pay, stuff I messed up. Or if I do fall asleep, I'll wake up way before it's light out, and it just... it feels like I didn't even sleep at all.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide lately?

Um... yeah. I guess. Just... thinking that maybe it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. It kind of... it got really intense a few days ago. I actually scared myself. That's... that's why I called the employee assistance program at work. I just... yeah.
Have you had any periods in the last month where you felt somewhat better for a few days?
No. Not really. It's just... it's just been the same.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt okay, or at least not as bad as you've been feeling lately?
Um... no. Like I said, it's... it's really just been the same. Not that I can remember, anyway. It's all just been... bad.
Can you think of anything that you used to enjoy doing before this period of feeling heavy and hopeless that you still find pleasure in now?
Um... no. Not really. I can't really think of anything. I just... I don't really care about doing much right now.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?
No. I... I think I just said, there really isn't anything. I just don't want to do anything right now.
Are there any small things that happen during the day that give you a little bit of pleasure?
No. I just... I don't really know what else to say. It's just all the same.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt somewhat better for a few days?
No. Not really. It's just been... heavy. Every day.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where your feelings of heaviness and hopelessness were significantly worse than they are right now?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed a difference. It just... it all feels the same.
Are there any activities that you used to think about doing in the future with pleasure or looking forward to, but now you don't?
I don't know. I can't really remember what I used to want to do. I just... I don't think about the future right now.
Have you been able to carry out your daily routine and work responsibilities without much difficulty despite feeling heavy and hopeless?

No. Not really. Work was... I was making some questionable calls. I kind of fell apart in a few meetings, so my supervisor had to take me off active project decisions. And at home... I just stopped keeping up with basic routines. It got to the point where... I ended up being sent to the emergency department. I just... I didn't feel safe with my thoughts.
